_comment: Reference data for Force Powers (spells.2da) and Feats (feat.2da), extracted via pykotor for the Force Powers native-grant research (see FutureDesign.md goal 1 / PHASE14.md). Keys are the real spell/feat row IDs (spell IDs match save-file KnownList0 Spell field format; feat IDs match KSE_GrantFeatArrayA/KSE_RemoveFeatArrayA). granted_<class>_level fields on feats are -1/None if never auto-granted, or the character level at which that class automatically receives it (straight from feat.2da, not inferred).
